messages:
ingrid: Heads up — perf blips on the embeddings endpoint when mixed-dim payloads appear. Saw 95/99 tail latency jump on small high-dim items. Anyone else seen this? repro inline.

sam: Can you paste an example request? Is this the splitter bouncing between routes or our preflight estimator getting fooled?

ingrid: Example payload: `vectors: [[0.1, ...] (dim=2048), [0.2, ...] (dim=64)]`. Router currently uses bytes + unit-estimator which assumes uniform dims -> it coalesces into routes that blow up memory/KV caches. CPU spikes on preflight and we see >1s extra latency.

kevin: Oof. Two viable paths: (A) add an explicit client header `X-Vector-Dims` so router can make a dim-aware decision without heavy preflight, (B) invest in estimator improvements + console toggle to force split-by-dim.

devex: @kevin adding a header is low friction server-side but breaks older SDKs. We could do best-effort: prefer header when present, fall back to estimator. Need telemetry to track how many requests actually include the header.

sam: Telemetry proposal: bump preflight sampling from 1% -> 10% for 24h to get signal. Also add metric `router.split_reason` with tags {bytes, dim_hint, estimator} so we can chart which path was chosen for mixed-dim requests.

ingrid: Strong +1. Console UX request: show per-request breakdown (route selection, units billed, dim distribution). Customers keep asking "why did a 2-vector request cost X tokens?" We need an explainability panel.

kevin: Implementation sketch: runtime accepts header; router short-circuits preflight when header present; otherwise falls back. Console: stacked waterfall per request showing decision points (prefetch, split, route). Rollout: opt-in via feature flag.

devex: Header shape suggestion: allow either single value for uniform dims or CSV for per-vector dims, e.g. `X-Vector-Dims: 2048,64`. Validate count matches `vectors.length`, otherwise return 400 with a helpful message and link to docs.

sam: To avoid immediate incompat, expose `X-Vector-Dims-V1` as experimental header. Instrument SDKs to emit it from next minor release; servers accept both.

ingrid: Rollout plan: canary 10% traffic -> monitor `embed.tail_99`, `router.prefetch_miss_rate`, and `route.unit_efficiency`. Abort if >5% regression on tail latency or >10% increase in units.

devex: :thumbsup: I'll draft SDK PR + doc blurb. Also propose a console banner whenever we detect mixed-dim traffic advising to try the dim header for better routing.

ingress-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `embed-router-dim-hint` 10% -> 1704201300

sam: Thanks team. After 24h sampling let's do a quick sync and final decisions on naming / console placement.
